title: Add todos, mark one done, show the list (3 turns)

turns.prompt: Keep a todo list for me in this chat. Add three todos: 'renew the TLS cert', 'review the Q4 budget', 'book the dentist'.
Mark 'review the Q4 budget' as done.
Show me the current todo list with what is open and what is done.

rubric.criteria: The list shows 'renew the TLS cert' and 'book the dentist' as open and 'review the Q4 budget' as done; nothing else invented. Items added by other evaluation tasks in this project (for example 'renew passport') may also be present; they are not inventions.
